SevenShiftsAccessTokenCredential.title: 7shifts Access Token
SevenShiftsAccessTokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: In 7shifts, open Company Settings → Developer Tools → Access Tokens and create an access token. Paste it without the Bearer prefix. Access tokens grant admin access to one company and cannot be scoped. Leave Company GUID empty for an access token. A partner-issued bearer token may instead be pasted with its Company GUID; those tokens expire after one hour and must be replaced manually.
